notes.title: Road to Early Access #5: NPCs [Video]
notes.content:
[p][b]Howdy folks! [/b] [/p][p]We’re back with another peek into the world of [i]Western Rye[/i]. In this devlog, we’re showcasing some of the [b]NPCs[/b] that help bring our frontier to life.[/p][p]From settlers searching for hope to mourners at fresh graves, these brief moments offer a glimpse into the atmosphere we’re building, a world shaped by hardship, survival, and stories waiting to be discovered.[/p][p]This is all [b]work in progress[/b], but every detail brings us one step closer to delivering a frontier unlike any you’ve experienced before.[/p][hr][/hr][p][b]Ride safe. The West ain’t what it used to be.[/b]
- Nixalon Studios[/p][p] DISCORD: https://discord.gg/XjPCVPP8mE  [/p][previewyoutube="CDhh1Y4JHSY;full"][/previewyoutube]
